name: dealer-agent-protocol
description: Build and deployment tooling for the Dealer Agent Protocol public sites.

scripts.pilot:list: wrangler d1 execute dealer-agent-pilot --config deployment/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, dealership_name, contact_name, work_email, status FROM pilot_applications ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.pilot:count: wrangler d1 execute dealer-agent-pilot --config deployment/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --remote --command "SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS applications FROM pilot_applications GROUP BY status ORDER BY status"
scripts.deploy:sites: npm run build:sites && npm run deploy:protocol && npm run deploy:product && npm run deploy:gateway-site
